text:
Predicates:
Popular(x) ::: x is a popular Netflix show.
BingeWatch(x, y) ::: y binge-watches x.
Download(x, y) ::: y downloads x.
Share(x, y) ::: y shares x with someone.
BlackMirror ::: the show "Black Mirror".
Karen ::: the person Karen.
Show(x) ::: x is a show.

Premises:
∀x (Popular(x) → BingeWatch(x, Karen)) ::: If a Netflix show is popular, Karen will binge-watch it.
∀x (BingeWatch(x, Karen) ↔ Download(x, Karen)) ::: If and only if Karen binge-watches a Netflix show, she will download it.
¬Download(BlackMirror, Karen) ::: Karen does not download "Black Mirror".
Show(BlackMirror) ::: "Black Mirror" is a Netflix show.
∀x (BingeWatch(x, Karen) → Share(x, Lisa)) ::: If Karen binge-watches a Netflix show, she will share it with Lisa.

Conclusion:
Share("Stranger Things", Lisa)
